text:
Alex R.: Posting consolidated follow-ups from the postmortem re: ACME Dedicated outage — VPC peering flaps + on-prem isolation bug. Need clear owners & timelines for remediation. TL;DR: recurring peering flaps across 3 incidents, and an on-prem node had asymmetric routing due to a misapplied firewall rule. Action items below.

Maria G.: I can own the VPC peering runbook updates and the configuration checklist. Target ETA 2025-03-10. Will include BGP graceful-restart and holdtime guidance.

Sanjay K.: I'll take on the on-prem sanity checks and the customer-facing checklist for firewall & routing. ETA 2025-03-14. Plan to create an automated health-check script we can share.

Priya L.: Assigning Eng-runtime follow-up to look at fallback routing policies — we observed 2 failed fallbacks during the outage. Creating ticket AI-124, due 2025-03-21.

DevOps Bot: Created ticket INF-3421 for runbook updates (owner: Maria G., due 2025-03-10).

Maria G.: Adding checklist snippet here for reference: ```
- verify BGP timers
- check route-maps and AS-path filters
- ensure peer HOLDTIME >= 90
- run `peer-health-check --peer <peer-ip>`
- document expected syslogs and MRT dumps
```

Alex R.: Can we add a recurring alert to detect peering jitter (short drops before full flap)? Who owns alerting?

Sanjay K.: @Priya L. can you triage alerting work? If not, ops will pick it up.

Priya L.: I will triage. Plan: add a 5m drop-count alert + 1h trend anomaly. ETA 2025-03-12. Will add runbook step to auto-escalate to oncall and CS.

Alex R.: Also need a customer comms plan. CS should confirm next steps with ACME. @Maria G. please sync and get approval before sending.

Maria G.: On it — draft comms ready, will send to CS and legal for review by EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident summary attached to INC-2025-03-01-ACME. Follow-ups created: INF-3421 (runbook), AI-124 (runtime fallback), INF-3422 (on-prem checks), ALERT-559 (peering jitter).

Sanjay K.: One more note — this looks like a recurring pattern: similar peering instability on 2024-11-22 and 2025-01-17. Recommend a recurrence review in the next SRE retro + measure to block repetitive customer impact.

Priya L.: Agreed. I'll add a retro agenda item: "Peering recurrence & global alerting thresholds."

Alex R.: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners, ticket links, and timelines, and will ping next week for status. Closing this thread for now — please post updates in the tickets and tag this thread if anything slips. :thumbsup:
